description: Pedagogical example index for agents, docs, and validation checks. Canonical examples teach typed Axiograph surfaces; storage/debug scripts are deliberately not the primary route.
quality_bar: Each cataloged example must teach a clear feature, scenario, flow, tool, or process.
Examples that only prove a command runs belong in tests, not the public teaching path.
Examples that use advisory or evidence-plane outputs must say so explicitly.
Non-catalog examples should be cataloged with a purpose or removed.

example_tiers.teaching: Start here: canonical .axi, .cq, typed reports, overlays, codegen previews, or semantic VCS examples with clear learning goals.
example_tiers.evidence_plane: Review/discovery inputs and generated candidate modules. Useful for engineering workflows, but not accepted ontology truth.
example_tiers.projection_or_ops: Backend projection, interop, or operational workflows. Useful for integration testing, not primary ontology authoring.

recommended_flow.surface: one canonical scenario spanning finite query proof, evolution, merge, persistence, projection, and generated tests
typed query certificates, definition reports, overlay validation, CQ/coverage reports
read-only codegen plans, continuous coverage profiles, explicit skeleton materialization
accepted-plane refs, dry-run merge/rebase plans, reduced Lean checker payloads
read-only TypeDB/TerminusDB/RDF/SHACL projection contracts from compiled IR
